notes: v597 — THE ROOT CAUSE, FOUND. Every 'why is PROMISING always 0, tried every combo' report today had the same real cause: the RADAR's own grade (the tiles, the strip, the PN Edge column) was ALWAYS computed on the server's default 5-day window, no matter what window you picked in the 📋 report card — the card's own popup used a separate, correct calculation, but the radar behind it never even asked the server for your chosen window, and its own cache-check never noticed the window had changed. So switching to 10d changed what the CARD showed while the RADAR kept reporting the same 5-day answer forever — two disagreeing grades on one screen. Fixed at the source: the radar's re-warm now requests the exact window you have selected, and correctly re-asks the server the moment you change it. The evidence strip will now say which window it counted (‘5-day’ or ‘10-day’) — read that line to know what the numbers in front of you mean. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
